Runtime identity and protocol fingerprints for every continuation-5 run.

Runtime identity is taken from each job's OWN record: every adapter hashes and
version-checks the binary it is about to run and writes that into raw-*/run.json. The
installed_now block is a live reading taken when this script runs, so a runtime that
changed mid-phase shows up as a disagreement instead of being papered over.

The protocol fingerprint is the first 16 hex characters of
sha256(json.dumps({file: sha256}, sort_keys=True)) over the key protocol files as the
run itself recorded them in run.json['protocol_sha256']. Runs sharing a fingerprint ran
identical code; nothing here is asserted from memory.
